OR Graduate in any discipline with 2 years' experience of administration work and a speed test of not less than 8000 key depressions per hour (kdph) on computer.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Assistant position is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have passed the 12th grade with 5 years of administrative experience and a typing speed of 8000 KDPH, or be a graduate with 2 years of administrative experience and the same typing speed.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Assistant post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per AIIMS/ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 21,751 per month for the Senior Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Senior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their Google Form applications, followed by an interview, which can be conducted offline or online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Senior Project Assistant position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Assistant recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity for the Senior Project Assistant post at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.
